gaps.sentence: It's no use ___ about the weather.
gaps.explanation: it's no use + -ing: no use complaining.

gaps.sentence: We managed ___ everyone before the storm hit.
You risk ___ your licence if you drink and drive.
I didn't mean ___ you — it was a joke.
gaps.explanation: mean (= intend) takes the to-infinitive: didn't mean to upset. (mean + -ing = involve.)

gaps.sentence: He apologized for ___ so abrupt in the meeting.
Is it worth ___ the engine or should we buy a new car?
I'm learning ___ the guitar at the moment.
gaps.explanation: learn takes the to-infinitive (learn how to play).

gaps.sentence: I really can't afford ___ on holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: afford takes the to-infinitive: can't afford to go.
